name: example-v2-coding-agent
description: Agentick v2 end-to-end example — a naive coding agent, driven over the wire by a client. Showcases the full client-side ergonomics built for v2: the batteries-included @agentick/client bundle, session sub-handles (session.knobs / session.tasks / session.elicitations), the execution token stream, and onLog — against a real JSX coding agent whose tools gate destructive writes through elicitation and run shell commands as tasks.
